findings.where: Footer links "Privacy", "Terms" and "Report content" at both widths, and the header wordmark ("MantaHostels home")
findings.fault: These look like links to a privacy policy, terms, a way to report content and the home page, but each one goes back to this same How we rank page. A visitor who clicks one lands where they started and nothing happens.
findings.who_objects: A backpacker who has just read that rankings can't be bought and wants to check the privacy policy or terms, or report a review that looks fake. Following the reporting path is the trust step this page invites. A dead link here makes the published method look like a façade. Anyone who taps the logo to go home is also stuck on this page.

findings.where: "Hostelworld, for comparison" section, the source in brackets (Hostelworld's help centre, "How long does a review stay on my page?", read 16 August 2026)
findings.fault: The page cites a competitor's policy as a source, but the citation is plain text, not a link. A reader who wants to check the claim has to find the article on their own.
findings.who_objects: A sceptical visitor reading on a phone who wants to confirm the comparison before trusting it. Copying the title into a search mid-trip is extra work, and that check is the reason this page exists.
